comment: The paragraph explains the interdependence of client, facility, workforce, LHR, and product registries. It does not address whether all provenance must resolve synchronously to authoritative registries at runtime or whether historical references and cached identifiers are acceptable.

public.text: The paragraph explains the interdependence of client, facility, workforce, LHR, and product registries. It does not address whether all provenance must resolve synchronously to authoritative registries at runtime or whether historical references and cached identifiers are acceptable.
public.suggestedRevision: Clarify that consuming records should retain stable identifiers and sufficient historical provenance. Runtime dependence on live registry availability should be minimised through caching, versioned references, and asynchronous reconciliation where appropriate.
